Lyrical Studies

“The most beautiful moments are often the quietest.”

The Lyrical Studies of contemporary artist Nona Dronova celebrate the quiet poetry of nature through spontaneous observation and expressive colour. Created directly from impressions of the garden, these paintings preserve the freshness of a fleeting moment — morning light, flowering trees, gentle shadows and the peaceful atmosphere of changing seasons.

Rather than seeking dramatic effects, these works reveal the beauty of ordinary moments that often pass unnoticed. Free brushwork, luminous colour and subtle harmony allow each painting to capture not only the appearance of nature but also its emotional presence.

For Nona Dronova, a lyrical study is more than a preliminary sketch. It is a complete artistic statement, where simplicity, sincerity and the joy of painting come together in a celebration of light, colour and the quiet rhythm of everyday life.
